facts.fact: 章首：怪物贴背嗅闻热气喷颈——她死忍不出声不丢下 Nelveen
facts.anchor: Hot puffs of air blew onto Andra’s neck as the monster sniffed, sticky strands of blood and spittle

facts.fact: 黑甲双足巨兽循声进巷——当街处决两只"失职"小怪（怪物军队有编制）
facts.anchor: The newcomer was larger than the others and stood on two legs, wearing dark armor that glinted in the moonlight

facts.fact: 让 Nelveen 原地藏身——独自穿死亡长街找 Quentin
facts.anchor: “I need you to stay here while I find Quentin,” she whispered against her forehead.

facts.fact: 巷中误袭队友：肘击+锁喉才认出是 Quentin——相拥；他闻险情转冰冷怒意
facts.anchor: Quentin’s hazel eyes met hers in the dark.

facts.fact: 分工手语：昆汀接 Nelveen 穿林东北边界外沿集合——吻额后策马冲出
facts.anchor: Get Nelveen and get through the woods. Meet us on the outskirts at the northeastern border.

facts.fact: 独行计划：独自赴东北海岸让 Vasara 一时伤不到朋友——"为了他们她可以勇敢"
facts.anchor: She could buy them more time to figure out how to destroy Vasara and the dark monstrosities she had created.

facts.fact: 屋顶战影：三打一——她一眼认出 Gerrick 的战斗风格（借力还施）
facts.anchor: But the third was quick and agile, his longsword in one hand, his dagger in the other.

facts.fact: 全力释放：风环掀飞数十只怪——不再压抑；粗根破土+火墙护昆汀突围
facts.anchor: A blast of wind shot from her body in a wide circle, and dozens of monsters flew backward through the air

facts.fact: 空中接应：呼哨唤 Bayard 加速——Gerrick 屋顶跃入空中以胸着落马背随即瘫软
facts.anchor: His chest landed on Bayard’s back behind her just before they reached the end of the flames

facts.fact: 章末：狂啸——从未施展过这样的魔法"她救了他们"；杀 Vasara 或者死在路上
facts.anchor: She would kill Vasara or die trying.
